anchors.statement: The installer must accept --github and --azure flags that select the provider commands rendered into the sc-compose templates.
anchors.quote: could we add --github and --azure flags which inject the proper commands into sc-compose j2 templates?
anchors.scope: adds or changes the installer, provider vars files, sc_render or templates that run PR commands

anchors.statement: The lite hook's transition logic must live in one Python file organized by transition type.
anchors.quote: The business logic is to be in a single small python file which is organized by transition type and enums w/ exhaustive checks (that will compile error if not handled)
anchors.scope: adds or changes the lite hook atm-bd-task-hook.py or splits logic out of it

anchors.statement: Every transition in the lite hook must be an enum matched exhaustively, so that a missing arm fails pyright strict.
anchors.quote: The business logic is to be in a single small python file which is organized by transition type and enums w/ exhaustive checks (that will compile error if not handled)
anchors.scope: adds or changes transition handling in the lite hook

anchors.statement: Lite hook tests must put each repeated setup or assertion pattern in a shared helper method.
anchors.quote: I want less code in the business logic.  test code is fine, but should be written efficiently w/ repeated patterns using common methods.
anchors.scope: adds or changes tests for the lite hook or lite cron

anchors.statement: The atm-bd console, cron and queues commands must serve lite and full phases through one unchanged command-line interface.
anchors.quote: Some items would be atm-bd-<profile> specific i.e. atm-bd-task-hook.py the task assignment j2 templates, the cron script.  We should use the same tool interfaces for atm-bd cron, atm-bd console, atm-bd queues (and others I may have missed).  This would mean that there would need to be atm-bd-core types that are shared between all profiles and I expect we would want the same schema, although atm-bd-lite would allow some mandetory schema items to be 'undefined' i.e. sanity.
anchors.scope: adds or changes atm-bd console, cron, queues, sprint-report or bv-analyze

anchors.statement: Both profiles must use the single bead schema defined in atm-bd-core.
anchors.quote: Some items would be atm-bd-<profile> specific i.e. atm-bd-task-hook.py the task assignment j2 templates, the cron script.  We should use the same tool interfaces for atm-bd cron, atm-bd console, atm-bd queues (and others I may have missed).  This would mean that there would need to be atm-bd-core types that are shared between all profiles and I expect we would want the same schema, although atm-bd-lite would allow some mandetory schema items to be 'undefined' i.e. sanity.
anchors.scope: adds or changes bead_schema, close_fields, bead models or formulas

anchors.statement: In the lite profile the sanity fields of the shared schema must be optional, left undefined rather than filled.
anchors.quote: Some items would be atm-bd-<profile> specific i.e. atm-bd-task-hook.py the task assignment j2 templates, the cron script.  We should use the same tool interfaces for atm-bd cron, atm-bd console, atm-bd queues (and others I may have missed).  This would mean that there would need to be atm-bd-core types that are shared between all profiles and I expect we would want the same schema, although atm-bd-lite would allow some mandetory schema items to be 'undefined' i.e. sanity.
anchors.scope: adds or changes bead_schema, close_fields or close vars

anchors.statement: Scripts and templates of either profile never invoke the gh stack subcommand or the GitHub stacks API.
anchors.quote: One item that also needs to be addressed both ATM – BD – lite and ATM – BD – orchestration is for GH stacking to work on non-GitHub repos, a.k.a. azure git repos.  This is something we should address at ATM BD lite phase buy only checking the base and top of work trees, not using the GH stack sub command
anchors.scope: adds or changes stack linking, stack checks, sanity-stack-link, or dispatch templates

anchors.statement: Stack checks must compare the PR base with the stack top using git alone.
anchors.quote: One item that also needs to be addressed both ATM – BD – lite and ATM – BD – orchestration is for GH stacking to work on non-GitHub repos, a.k.a. azure git repos.  This is something we should address at ATM BD lite phase buy only checking the base and top of work trees, not using the GH stack sub command
anchors.scope: adds or changes the stack gate or stack linking

anchors.statement: The dev and fix close hook must refuse the close when the PR base differs from the stack top, before running bd close and atm task close.
anchors.quote: 1) dev/fix 'atm task close' would check pr base vs. stack top (blocking close if not stacked properly) then do bd close, atm task close.
anchors.scope: adds or changes a dev or fix close hook or the stack gate

anchors.statement: A phase never contains beads of more than one profile.
anchors.quote: 2) never mix profiles in the same phase.
anchors.scope: adds or changes phase-config, validate-plan, bead-groups or bead_schema

anchors.statement: Profile-specific scripts and templates must live under their own skill directory, skills/<profile>/scripts and skills/<profile>/templates.
anchors.quote: i would expect the atm-bd-lite only scripts to be in skills/atm-bd-lite/scripts/  and templates in atm-bd-lite/templates/ w/ corresponding atm-bd-orchestration scripts/stemplates located relative to the skill.  scripts/templates would be at a common point (which perhaps would best be at repo root in .atm-bd/scripts and /templates.  That would remove duplicates across .claude/ .codex/ and .agents/ that exist today
anchors.scope: adds or moves scripts or templates of a profile

anchors.statement: Shared scripts and templates must be installed once, to .atm-bd/scripts and .atm-bd/templates at the repository root.
anchors.quote: i would expect the atm-bd-lite only scripts to be in skills/atm-bd-lite/scripts/  and templates in atm-bd-lite/templates/ w/ corresponding atm-bd-orchestration scripts/stemplates located relative to the skill.  scripts/templates would be at a common point (which perhaps would best be at repo root in .atm-bd/scripts and /templates.  That would remove duplicates across .claude/ .codex/ and .agents/ that exist today
anchors.scope: adds, moves or installs shared scripts or templates

anchors.statement: The atm-bd-lite profile must ship its own task-close hook file, separate from the full profile's atm-task-close.py.
anchors.quote: the atm-bd-lite would have a completely different atm-task-hook python file.
anchors.scope: adds or changes a task-close hook, or selects a hook by profile

anchors.statement: The lite profile must run a phase end to end with a single agent and no sanity stage.
anchors.quote: we haven't designed 'lite' yet. it will be a much simpler orchestration that could be run by a single agent or small team.
anchors.scope: adds or changes the lite skill, lite formulas or lite templates

anchors.statement: New or rewritten Python code in the phase must return Result values for expected failures instead of raising, and every touched file must pass pyright strict.
anchors.quote: ok, are we following the unwritten python-best-practices?  use pyright, return Result<T,Err> (no throwing), can you define rust traits for python to use?
anchors.scope: adds or rewrites Python code in atm-bd-orchestration

anchors.statement: The fundamental atm-bd types must live in one Rust crate distributed through crates.io and a PyPI abi3 wheel, never through a git-source or GitHub-asset pin.
anchors.quote: I am fine w/ you building a rust crate w/ the fundamental types if it can easily be distributed. does wheel pull from gh?
anchors.scope: adds or changes shared enums, error types, provider or stack-gate types, or their distribution

anchors.statement: The lite hook's transition logic must be a pure function returning a command plan, with no I/O, so a Rust cron can fire it under monty or CPython.
anchors.quote: rust libraries will be arriving soon which will replace beads cache w/ rust and tokio and cron for firing monty (or python hooks).
anchors.scope: adds or changes the lite hook or the hook runner

anchors.statement: The atm-bd-types crate must be versioned and released independently of the Python package, so a Python-only fix never publishes the crate.
anchors.quote: I am hopeful we won't be changing the atm-bd crate too often so we don't need a complicated publish process for quick python fixes
anchors.scope: adds or changes release workflows, version files or the crate pin
